description: Prefix reads: range requests with prefix_base64 (RANGE-1), alone and intersected with start and end. A prefix read of p equals the range from p to successor(p), or unbounded above when p has no successor (section 6.2).

families.prefix/prefix-only: a range with only prefix_base64; asserted equal to the range from p to successor(p)
families.prefix/prefix-with-bounds: prefix intersected with start and end

cases.description: start above every key with the prefix; prefix intersected with start/end
exclusive start equal to the prefix; prefix intersected with start/end
spans a part boundary; prefix intersected with start/end
